channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Data center double-down: Hassett says blue wave won't stop AI build-out
item.description: Data centers are a crucial part of President Donald Trump's push to win the global artificial intelligence race, which he continues despite the midterm results.

item.title: Trump says Stephen Miller to replace Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff
item.description: Trump revealed the shake-up three days after Democrats' landslide victory in the midterm elections, winning majority control of the House and Senate.

item.title: A disturbing employment trend is hiding beneath the latest strong job numbers
item.description: The average jobless worker's bout of unemployment surpassed 27 weeks in October, the highest outside of the pandemic period in a decade.

item.title: U.S. economy added 165,000 jobs in October, way more than expected; unemployment rate slips to 4.1%
item.description: Nonfarm payrolls were expected to increase by 59,000 in October as the unemployment rate was expected to hold steady at 4.2%.

item.title: Nasdaq attempts to recover from worst rout in 19 months as AI stocks see some buying: Live updates
item.description: A bout of hard selling battered the stock market Thursday, sending the three major averages to their worst session since April 2025.

item.title: OpenAI bugging suspect Alfozan pleads not guilty
item.description: Saudi national Abdulrahman Alfozan is charged with planting a recording device in a conference room at artificial intelligence giant OpenAI.

item.title: Further turmoil could be in store for tech stocks. What to watch in the week ahead
item.description: Investors are wrapping up a topsy-turvy week in markets, and that volatility isn't expected to end just yet.

item.title: Top House Oversight Democrat warns Trump family to 'lawyer up'
item.description: With Democrats set to take control of the House in January, Rep. Robert Garcia is promising sweeping probes into Trump, his family and his administration.

item.title: Americans are on a 'treadmill of high inflation' and more rate hikes are likely, Fed's Daly says
item.description: San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly called Friday's jobs report "good news for American workers," but noted the pressure inflation is exerting on household finances

item.title: AI crush is powering one stock to sky-high valuations
item.description: Despite sky-high valuations, Mike Khouw argues Costco shares could present a compelling buy.

item.title: Jay Rockefeller, heir to famed dynasty and healthcare advocate in U.S. Senate, dies at 89
item.description: John D. "Jay" Rockefeller IV, the progeny of one of America's most famous and wealthiest families, died on Friday at his home in Washington. He was 89.

item.title: Mississippi Senate: Longshot Ty Pinkins says he aimed to spoil Hyde-Smith, boost Colom vote
item.description: Ty Pinkins said he avoided campaigning in heavily Black areas of Mississippi to avoid harming chances for Democrat Scott Colom, who, like him, is Black.

item.title: The AI ‘credit card’ is getting costlier as CoreWeave bond yield tops 16%
item.description: Coreweave's steep yields reflect stress in the AI debt markets as investors worry about a data center slowdown. What comes next.

item.title: Tesla to wind down Cybertruck production in Texas next year to ramp Cybercab, Musk says
item.description: The Cybertruck and its polarizing design gained a niche following, but it did not achieve mass-market sales and Tesla has issued several voluntary recalls.

item.title: Democratic sweep gives markets a reason to rethink path of interest rates
item.description: Rate hikes could be curbed by an Iran war resolution, slower U.S. growth and fresh fiscal policy — but none are set in stone.

item.title: This pharmaceutical ETF is outperforming. Why it could keep climbing
item.description: The Invesco Pharmaceuticals ETF continues to outperform as other areas of the market weaken, making it an investment opportunity worth watching.

item.title: Wall Street's fear gauge may be flashing a buy sign
item.description: History shows that similar spikes in the VIX have been good entry points for stocks

item.title: Watch the Annual Meeting: Cramer on the fate of the AI buildout and stocks to buy now
item.description: At the Investing Club's 4th annual meeting, Cramer also reveals his outlook for 2027 and answers questions from the live audience and members at home.

item.title: Nasdaq drops into correction territory — here’s what typically happens next
item.description: Nasdaq’s slide into correction territory puts its history of recoveries in focus. Here's what history shows.

item.title: Fake job interview scams like the one that hit Binance are getting more sophisticated. Here are the new signs to watch for
item.description: Binance lost more than $6 billion in a hack partly caused by fake job interviews. Here's what job seekers can learn from it, and tips to avoid job search scams.

item.title: Market sell-off hits hard: Advisors say 'stay the course with an eye on buying'
item.description: As retail investors pulled money out of individual stocks, more than three-quarters of advisors in a CNBC flash poll said investors should check their allocation against their goals or stay invested.

item.title: Credit feels harder to get. Here’s what to do before applying for a new credit card
item.description: With the holidays approaching, CNBC Select covers what you should know if you’re hoping to get a new credit card this season.

item.title: Moderna raises 2026 outlook as CEO says newer vaccines are gaining traction
item.description: The biotech company now expects 2026 revenue growth of 15% to 25%, up from its previous guidance of up to 10%.

item.title: Anthropic IPO announcement odds drop on Kalshi following midterms and AI sell-off
item.description: Kalshi traders cut the odds of an Anthropic IPO announcement before December as AI stocks sold off after Democrats won control of Congress.

item.title: AI debt concerns grow as ING reportedly seeks buyers for $500 million of data center loans
item.description: ING is reportedly seeking bids for about $500 million across 12 data center loans, including debt tied to a New Mexico Stargate site.

item.title: A long-term Elon Musk backer is cashing out of Tesla — and cutting its SpaceX exposure
item.description: Scottish Mortgage Investment Trust has cut its SpaceX holding to 11.1% of assets and sold its remaining Tesla stake.

item.title: Where's the growth? Legacy automakers face a tougher 2027 as costs rise, market tightens
item.description: Automakers are warning about higher commodity, logistics and memory costs, while pricing power is becoming harder to extend to consumers.

item.title: Montana votes to ban corporate political money. Next stop? Probably the Supreme Court
item.description: Montana voters approved a novel strategy to restrict corporate political spending, setting up a constitutional fight that could reach the Supreme Court.

item.title: Family offices boost startup investments in October, backing women's health and caregivers
item.description: Laurene Powell Jobs' Emerson Collective was the most active family-office investor with three startup bets.

item.title: Small retailers brace for 'huge hit' this holiday season as shipping costs spike
item.description: As shipping costs surge due to high fuel prices, smaller and medium-sized retailers struggle to keep up, and they face a difficult holiday season.
